nodes.label: macOS Platform Icons
nodes.description: macOS app icons across sizes: 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024px. Uses the default Flutter logo (light-blue geometric chevrons on white rounded square, dark navy accent) — the macOS variant was not updated to the custom food-plate brand icon. This represents a branding inconsistency: Android and iOS use the custom food icon; macOS still shows the Flutter default.
